desc:
🏃‍♂️ Run, slide and freeze in TAG RUSH! ❄️

🔪 Taggers hunt with a knife: one hit freezes you solid.
💨 Runners stay on the move: slide under swings, wall run, double jump and break ankles to escape, then sneak back to thaw frozen teammates! 🧊

🎮 MODES
❄️ Classic freeze tag
🧟 Infection
💣 Hot Potato

⚡ Upgrade abilities that bend the chase
🎁 Unlock knife skins, tag and save effects, emotes and titles from crates, the reward wheel and the reward path
📅 Daily quests, plus free rewards for joining the group, favoriting and liking 👍

🕹️ CONTROLS
💻 PC
WASD: move · Space: jump (again in the air to double jump) · Shift: run
C / Ctrl: slide (out of a run) · Left click: slash · Right click / E: throw
Q: ability · E: rescue · B: emotes · V: spectate (Q / E: switch player)

🎮 Controller
Left stick: move · A: jump · L3: run · B: slide
R2: slash · L2: throw · Y: ability · X: rescue
D-pad Up: emotes · D-pad Down: spectate (LB / RB: switch player)

📱 Mobile
Thumbstick: move · Tap the scree
